import datetime,hashlib,json,os,pathlib,signal,subprocess,time
out=pathlib.Path('simulations/outputs/rich6d_rough_sr3_extended_v2')
parent,worker,index=28384,70634,53
record=out/'remote_local_handoff.json'
def now(): return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
def ps(pid): return subprocess.run(['ps','-p',str(pid),'-o','stat=,ppid=,command='],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.strip()
def write(data):
 tmp=record.with_suffix('.tmp');tmp.write_text(json.dumps(data,indent=2)+'\n');os.replace(tmp,record)
qualification=json.loads((out/'remote_reproduction_results.json').read_text())
assert qualification['job_conclusion']=='success' and qualification['result']['passed']
assert '-m simulations.extended.production --workers 1' in ps(parent)
assert 'multiprocessing.spawn' in ps(worker) and int(ps(worker).split()[1])==parent
checkpoint=out/'production_baseline/P4096'/f'rep_{index:03d}.npz'
resources=out/'production_baseline'/f'resources_{index:03d}.json'
assert not resources.exists(), 'Checkpoint already closed: identify the currently running worker before stopping admission.'
state=dict(status='freezing_local_admission',supervisor_pid=parent,worker_pid=worker,index=index,started_utc=now(),qualification_sha256=hashlib.sha256((out/'remote_reproduction_results.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),reason='Transfer remaining deterministic indices to the successfully qualified standard macOS runners.',scientific_protocol_unchanged=True)
write(state)
os.kill(parent,signal.SIGSTOP)
try:
 assert 'multiprocessing.spawn' in ps(worker) and int(ps(worker).split()[1])==parent
 state.update(status='waiting_for_current_checkpoint',admission_frozen_utc=now());write(state)
 while not (checkpoint.exists() and resources.exists()):
  current=ps(worker)
  if not current or current.startswith('Z'): raise RuntimeError('Worker exited without both checkpoint and resource record.')
  time.sleep(.25)
 metadata=json.loads(resources.read_text())
 assert metadata['index']==index and metadata['run_hash']==qualification['result']['run_hash']
 for _ in range(120):
  current=ps(worker)
  if not current or current.startswith('Z'): break
  time.sleep(.25)
 else: raise RuntimeError('Worker did not exit after writing its complete checkpoint.')
 assert '-m simulations.extended.production --workers 1' in ps(parent)
 os.kill(parent,signal.SIGTERM);os.kill(parent,signal.SIGCONT)
 for _ in range(120):
  current=ps(parent)
  if not current or current.startswith('Z'): break
  time.sleep(.25)
 else: raise RuntimeError('Supervisor did not stop after controlled handoff.')
 state.update(status='local_admission_stopped_after_saved_checkpoint',finished_utc=now(),checkpoint_sha256=hashlib.sha256(checkpoint.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),checkpoint_completed_utc=metadata['completed_utc'],note='The enclosing local advance supervisor will report its child termination; this is an intentional scheduling handoff, not a scientific failure. Remote allocation follows an independent checkpoint audit.')
 write(state);print(json.dumps(state),flush=True)
except Exception:
 if '-m simulations.extended.production --workers 1' in ps(parent): os.kill(parent,signal.SIGCONT)
 raise
